links.description: File resides in the Next.js app's public/ directory (public/logo.png), the conventional location for static assets served directly by the app, implying it is used as the app's displayed logo (e.g., header, sidebar, favicon, or login screen) for the internal management system built for Transportes Pucarani.

Logo depicts a circular blue-and-yellow emblem combining stylized letters 'T' and 'P' inside a ring, with white negative space, above two-line wordmark text 'TRANSPORTES' (smaller) and 'PUCARANI' (larger, bold) in dark blue — this is the visual brand mark of the transportation company Transportes Pucarani.

links.note: File sits in public/ of a Next.js app (sistema-gestion) with the exact markup of the default vercel.svg shipped by create-next-app; likely unused leftover scaffold asset rather than an intentionally added brand asset.
SVG is the solid white triangle glyph (viewBox 0 0 1155 1000, single path), the standard Vercel wordmark triangle icon.

links.evidence: File is located at src/app/icon.svg, which is the Next.js App Router's reserved special-file convention for auto-generating the app's favicon/icon metadata; no explicit config links it, so this is inferred from file placement and naming.

SVG (64x64, teal rounded-square background #0f766e) depicts a simplified vehicle glyph: a white rounded rectangle body containing two square window shapes and a bumper/grille bar, sitting above two white circular wheels — a minivan/bus-like silhouette. This visually aligns with the app's domain as a management system for a transportation company (Transportes Pucarani) with vehicle/taxi fleet features referenced elsewhere in the project.
